preconditions.description: The number of queries t must be between 1 and 100,000.
The order of the graph n must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**16 and 1 <= bi <= 10**16 and ai != bi for ai, bi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must contain valid vertex numbers ai and bi, where ai and bi are distinct and within the range of 1 to 10^16.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the lengths of the shortest paths for each query, separated by newlines.
